exposure: mode of birth (cesarean section vs. spontaneous vaginal delivery)
cohort: The study included 384 participants, who were mothers attending the Entebbe Regional Referral Hospital in Central Uganda.
finding: Delayed initiation of breastfeeding is common and significantly associated with maternal age groups of 15-24 years and 25-34 years (compared to 35-45 years) and delivery through cesarean section.
mod_finding: Delivery through cesarean section was significantly associated with delayed initiation of breastfeeding compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: Data were collected between October 1, 2019, and December 20, 2019.
